name: VOSIM
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' VOSM: two sine formants under a bell window the played note restarts. Both formant pitches are absolute and set independently, reaching pairs Granular Formant's ratio control cannot, and the 2:1 balance is a knob.

controls.label: Formant 2
controls.description: The second formant's pitch, also absolute and set independently of the first.

controls.label: Formant 1
controls.description: The first formant's pitch, absolute rather than tracking the note.

controls.label: Window
controls.description: Sets how much of each cycle the bell spends opening: a narrow spike, the module's one sixteenth, or half.

controls.label: Balance
controls.description: Shifts weight between the two formants, from formant 2 alone to formant 1 alone. The detent is the module's fixed 2:1.

outputs.main: The grain train at the set balance.
outputs.aux: The same grain train with the balance mirrored, favouring the formant MAIN does not.
